notes.title: Small Update before world 12
notes.content: [p]Changes: [/p][list][*][p]added main menu parallax setting[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]added high quality pen setting[/p][/*][*][p]added pixelate menu screen setting[/p][/*][*][p]settings should properly save now, first it was only the keybinds that saved, now everything saves whenever changed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Bugfixes: [/p][list][*][p]achievements loading properly, it was a bit messy at first, now there's a proper "step 1 script, step 2, step 3 script" which should always work.[/p][/*][*][p]walljumping on the barriers isn't doable anymore[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Soon world 12![/p]

notes.title: Small changes :p
notes.content:
What is new/changed?

- map displays world nr and world name
- changed the spike hitbox so it appears properly
- changed the deathbox for ceiling and left/right border, so it occur happen less
- updated the menu screen, it's more detailed
- removed some of the end block assets because they were unused
- made a few levels a bit easier, will make more levels that I think are too hard easier soon.

notes.title: Small update, 30 new achievements!
notes.content: [p]I added 30 new achievements to collect! some bugfixes here and there too. Also some slight nerfs to some levels :p added a pause button on the top left too, temporary thing but it works. I also made the timer in game how it should(first it didn't work properly)[/p]

notes.title: Added more "indicators"
notes.content:
[b]What has changed/been added?[/b]

- In the worldmap I added an indicator so you can track the amount of normal levels beaten and amount of hard levels beaten.
- I hope I have fixed the status when ingame, otherwise I'll try to fix it(again)
- Made the remove slot function more clear, it now shows a prompt if you want to remove all your data.
- Faster world map loading
- The editor now doesn't load any older levels, in next patch will fix that and more! I'll also try to add some things from the reddit post
